fact: On 3 September 2024 the director of the Civil Status Authority presented the phases of the Intilaqa project to the Prime Minister and the acting Interior Minister, stating that 257 civil status offices across Libya had completed matching and scanning of paper records against the electronic data, covering 1.8 million families or 97 per cent of Libyan families; the Prime Minister ordered the project timetable updated. It states no count of offices entering events digitally and no source of finance.
title: رئيس حكومة الوحدة الوطنية يتابع تنفيذ مشروع الانطلاقة الذي يستهدف تنظيم ومطابقة البيانات الإلكترونية ببيانات السجلات الورقية
